title: Wire CI as a PR gate behind the cost switch, with a local simulator
spec: The CI workflow only runs on workflow_dispatch, so PRs merge without any automated check. Wire pull_request and push-to-main triggers into the CI workflow while keeping every job guarded by the ENABLE_GITHUB_HOSTED_RUNNERS repo variable so nothing spends money until an admin flips it. Add an activation helper that flips the variable and sets branch protection, and a local simulator that parses the workflow file and executes the same steps locally so the gate can be exercised before runners are enabled.
